author: Corridor Crew
description:
The movie Sinners is widely recognised for the clone effects that were used to create the illusion of the twins Stack and Smoke, both played by Michael B. Jordan. So much so that a huge amount of VFX went unnoticed in creating the world of 1930s South US, on which the movie is based.

Did you notice how much of the staging was actually CGI?
title: Most of the VFX in this Movie were HIDDEN!
